newsitem.title: CHINA: Deng's funeral set for February 25.
newsitem.headline: Deng's funeral set for February 25.

text.p: The funeral of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping will be held next Tuesday in Beijing's cavernous Great Hall of the People, the Funeral Committee announced on Thursday.
The ceremony would not include a lying in state of Deng's body with mourners filing past, the committee said.
Deng always eschewed the cult of personality that surrounded his predecessor Mao Zedong and had said he wanted a simple memorial ceremony.
Ceremonies to pay respects to his remains would be held after his cremation, the committee said.
